title: Qwen3-Next-80B-A3B-Instruct FP8 on vLLM: one 128GB Spark
slug_note: 82.1GB of FP8 weights on a 128GB unified box: resident with ~30GB left for the KV pool.

variation.revision_note: HF snapshot of Qwen/Qwen3-Next-80B-A3B-Instruct-FP8 resolved and served on the Spark during the 2026-10-26 test

engine.config: Stock vLLM on one GB10; hybrid Gated DeltaNet attention, so cap max-model-len to keep a usable KV pool

requirements.notes: Measured on a DGX Spark (2026-10-26): 110.5 GiB dropped from MemAvailable with the recipe as written (vLLM default --gpu-memory-utilization (0.9), so this is the reservation, not the model's minimum need). That is vLLM's 0.9 reservation of the shared pool, not the model's minimum need. Earlier estimate: 82.1GB weights on 128GB unified; full 262K single-stream or shorter context with concurrency, not both.

Size computed from the HF API.

Works as written on a DGX Spark (2026-10-26), in vllm/vllm-openai:v0.32.0 with the HF cache mounted: server ready 811 s after `docker run` (weights from local disk, kernel autotune included); the functional check passed. 110.5 GiB dropped from MemAvailable is vLLM's default 0.9 reservation of the 128 GB pool, not the model's minimum need.
